work.title: Define the skill manifest schema and skill identity
work.description: Give a skill a machine-readable identity the Core can validate: id, version, kind, declared capabilities, and a content digest, declared beside SKILL.md and parsed strictly. Follows the conventions src/core/initiative.ts already sets — an exported schema version and type, an id regex beside the others in src/core/identifiers.ts, a parser that refuses unknown fields, and a slugOf-style rule for anything derived from prose. Identity and validation only: no resolution, no dependency evaluation, no persistence on a run. Kinds start at the two the repository can justify today, stage and secondary; more are additive later. The seven shipped skills gain manifests, and package.json already ships skills/, so they travel with the release.
acceptance: A skill manifest parses only with a valid id, version, kind, and declared capabilities, and a misspelled or unknown field is refused rather than dropped
Every skill under skills/ carries a manifest that parses, and its content digest is reproducible from the skill file alone
A CLI read lists the available skills with their id, version, kind, and digest, and changes nothing
Skill files stay harness-neutral: no manifest names a harness, and src/test/harness-adapters.test.ts still passes
